## About
Climaxx Motorsports is a family-owned and operated shop in Newport, serving Northern Kentucky with honest and professional maintenance and repair. We're equipped for diesel engine repair, fleet maintenance and gas vehicle maintenance, and we keep up with the latest automotive technology.
Joe runs the shop, and he'll take the time to walk you through a problem, even over the phone. One reviewer, traveling from out of town, said we were the only shop willing to look at their Jeep. Another calls himself a customer for life.
We're rated 4.6 from 45 Google reviews. Come by 4724 Mary Ingles Hwy or give us a call at (859) 866-4323.

## Services
- Fleet/Diesel/Gas Maintenance & Repair: Keeping fleet vehicles running smoothly, including removing old, worn-out gear oil from the front and rear differential and transfer cases.
- Engines, Turbos, Injectors: Seasonal maintenance or just getting a piece of equipment running again, including small engine work.
- Advanced Diagnostic: Inspections, repairs and maintenance that help keep small problems from turning into larger ones.
- Lift/Leveling Kit Sales & Install: Suspension lifts for more off-road clearance, room for larger aftermarket wheels, or a more aggressive look.
- Performance Alignment: Suspension work that keeps your ride smooth and helps you keep control of your vehicle.
- Custom Wheel/Tire Sales & Install: Wheel and tire sales, plus mounting and balancing.
- Over The Counter Accessory Sales: Accessories to make your vehicle more personal, stylish and functional.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on diesel trucks and fleet vehicles?
A: Yes. We handle diesel engine repair, fleet maintenance and gas vehicle maintenance.

Q: Can you lift my truck?
A: Yes. We sell and install lift and leveling kits, whether you want more off-road clearance, room for bigger wheels, or just a more aggressive look.

Q: Will you mount tires on wheels I bought somewhere else?
A: One reviewer brought in wheels purchased elsewhere and had tires mounted and balanced on them here.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
